description: Override heartbeat model to use local qwen3.5:4b instead of cloud glm-5.2 for COO agent, saving cloud token costs on routine monitoring heartbeats
rationale: COO heartbeat runs every hour (24 times/day) for infrastructure checks: cron job health, memory file existence, Ollama server health, dream report status, and git workspace status. These are simple shell commands with pass/fail output parsing. The local model (qwen3.5:4b) handles this easily. Using glm-5.2:cloud for these checks wastes cloud tokens. Cloud model still used for: agent coordination, weekly reports, strategy sessions, memory consolidation, cross-agent decisions, and Chris interactions. HEARTBEAT.md has been rewritten with explicit if/then decision trees optimized for the local model's capability level.
risk_assessment: LOW — heartbeat model override only affects automated polling runs. Interactive sessions still use primary model (glm-5.2:cloud). If local model struggles with a check, it escalates per HEARTBEAT.md protocol. No risk to agent coordination, strategy, or other agent functionality.
backup_plan: If local model heartbeats cause issues, remove the model override to revert to cloud model for all heartbeats.
checks_defined: Check 4: Dream report status (after 4 AM CT)
Check 5: Git workspace uncommitted changes count
